integrity: The model and one-target expected-descendant-reward formula are credited to Li, Huang, Lee and Eun (2023). The new claims concern complete-tree depth log-concavity, ordered Erlang-stage optimization transitions and a sharp first-layer-to-second-layer boundary. Mathematical claims are analytically proved and exact finite calculations are reproducible; independently performed scientific validation is absent.
scientific_limitations: One root source; one target; independent homogeneous exponential SI edge-transmission clocks; Erlang maturation; finite complete rooted trees.
Expected protection reward counts strict descendants, not the immunized vertex itself; alternate reward conventions change finite-height thresholds.
No claims about multiple vaccines, recovery, heterogeneity, non-tree contact graphs, empirical effectiveness or independently verified publication priority.
title: Erlang immunization stages induce exact vaccination-depth transitions on complete rooted trees
